title: AdGuard Encrypted DNS Client Adoption
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=adguard:query
| bin _time span=1w
| stats dc(eval(if(encrypted="true",client,null()))) as encrypted_clients, dc(client) as total_clients by _time
| eval adoption_pct=round(100*encrypted_clients/total_clients,1)
| where total_clients>0
| sort - _time
description: Uses AdGuard Home query logs telemetry to monitor the share of clients using encrypted DNS paths in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for whether network privacy settings are reaching the devices you care about, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest AdGuard Home query logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Weekly chart of encrypted-DNS client adoption.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds the share of clients using encrypted DNS paths so you can spot whether network privacy settings are reaching the devices you care about before it becomes annoying.
